content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NISE Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 13-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NISE Senior Project Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 13th October 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Project Scientist role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech in relevant disciplines with 8 years of experience or an M.Tech/MS in a relevant discipline with 4 years of experience. Specific disciplines are listed in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Project Scientist position is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India rules for reserved categories and for PhD holders.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 1,20,000/- per month for the first year, Rs. 1,25,000/- for the second year, and Rs. 1,30,000/- for the third year.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Senior Project Scientist position at the National Institute of Solar Energy (NISE).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application process for NISE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process is via email. Candidates need to send their complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Senior Project Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their academic records, qualifications, and experience, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these Senior Project Scientist positions?
faq.answer: The positions are contractual in nature, offering a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the National Institute of Solar Energy (NISE) located?
faq.answer: The National Institute of Solar Energy (NISE) is located in Gurugram, Haryana, with the pincode 122003.
